% Units as the PDF sets them: nicefrac's and xfrac's fractions with a
% slash (MathJax has neither), and siunitx's numbers, units, and quantities
% in text, in math, and in a display (MathJax has none of siunitx's
% commands). \, in text, which TeX never breaks.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\usepackage{nicefrac}
\usepackage{xfrac}
% siunitx.4ht loads color, which tex4ht then does not configure (see
% test-units-nocolor). xcolor in the preamble keeps the colors.
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage{siunitx}
\DeclareSIUnit\pct{\%}
\begin{document}
Half of $\nicefrac{1}{2}$ is $\sfrac{1}{4}$, and $\nicefrac[\mathrm]{a}{b}$.

Text: \num{12345.678}, \num{1.5e-3}, \SI{3}{\meter\per\second},
\qty{9.81}{\metre\per\square\second}, \si{\kilo\gram}, \unit{\joule},
\ang{30}, \numrange{1}{5}, \qtyrange{1}{5}{\kelvin}, \numlist{1;2;3},
\qtylist{1;2}{\metre}, \qty{2}{\percent},
{\sisetup{mode=text}\qty{1.5}{\metre}}, \qty{3}{\pct}.

At the end of a line, a quantity in text mode stays on one line, as it
does in the PDF, like {\sisetup{mode=text}\qty{1.5}{\metre}}. Thin
spaces in text: i.\,e., \textit{e.\,g.}, and 10\,000.

Math: $v = \SI{3}{\meter\per\second}$, $\qty[per-mode=fraction]{9.81}{\metre\per\square\second}$,
$\num{1.5e-3} + \unit{\joule}$, $\num{1234567.89123}$, $\ang{30}$,
$\qty{2}{\micro\metre}$, $\qty{4}{\degreeCelsius}$, $\qty{5}{\ohm}$.
Without siunitx: $90^\circ$, $20\,{}^\circ\mathrm{C}$, $25\,^\circ\mathrm{C}$, and an interior $A^\circ$.
Ranges, lists, products, and complex numbers: $\numrange{1}{5}$,
$\qtyrange{1}{5}{\kelvin}$, $\numlist{1;2;3}$, $\qtylist{1;2}{\metre}$,
$\numproduct{2 x 3}$, $\qtyproduct{2 x 3}{\metre}$, $\complexnum{1+2i}$,
$\complexqty{1+2i}{\ohm}$, and the older
$\SIrange{2}{6}{\kelvin}$ and $\SIlist{3;4}{\metre}$, with options:
$\numrange[range-phrase={\ \text{through}\ }]{3}{7}$,
$\numproduct[product-mode=phrase]{4 x 5}$, $\numrange[range-phrase=--]{1}{2}$,
$\numrange[range-phrase=\textendash]{3}{4}$.
\begin{align}
  E &= \qty{1.6e-19}{\joule}
\end{align}
\end{document}
